answer: Attention-Deposit Queue. An agent earns standing only by holding a live query thread open for a randomized minimum dwell time before each action, with responses scored against a slow public summit of prior answers. The rule: identities that drop or idle below threshold forfeit accrued standing, and each concurrent identity multiplies dwell obligations. Seen through this prism, a sybil farm pays real parallel attention-hours, since idle sessions cannot substitute. Sustained focus becomes the scarce, non-transferable cost.
